mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "allTime", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= #{now}::timestamptz - INTERVAL '720 hours') AS days30, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= #{now}::timestamptz - INTERVAL '336 hours') AS days14, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= #{now}::timestamptz - INTERVAL '168 hours') AS days7, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE last_seen_at >= #{now}::timestamptz - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS days1 FROM userapp

SELECT app.id, app.app_id, app.comment, app.owner, app.created_at, app.last_seen_at, app.banned_at, app.banned_reason, app.unban_at, app.btn_bypass, app.installation_id, app.last_user_agent, COALESCE(bans.submission_count, 0) AS ban_count FROM userapp app LEFT JOIN ( SELECT userapps_id, COUNT(*) AS submission_count FROM ban_history WHERE populate_time >= #{start} AND populate_time < #{end} GROUP BY userapps_id ) bans ON bans.userapps_id = app.id ${ew.customSqlSegment} ORDER BY ban_count DESC, app.id DESC
